page.overview:
Who is Peter Hahn?

Peter Hahn (born 27 June 1909 and died 10 December 1991) was a German-born American racing driver who raced sports cars in the United States. At the 1952 Indianapolis 500, he tried to qualify for the race, but was ultimately unsuccessful.
